title: platform objects: three generated translation bundles give two visible fields of one object the same label (sys_import_job ru, sys_oauth_resource ar, sys_user fr)
body:
domain:spec#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mecqk8M5q9vjKj6aS

Filing gate: ① (an out-of-scope finding of #33545 / PR #33639: dev report 6888745802, confirmed by the contract review 6888857868 section ③; the dev's `carrier: none`).

**What is wrong.** Read on PR #33639's head (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/`), each pair is two non-hidden fields of one platform object carrying one label in one locale, so a reader in that locale sees two identical column headers:
- `ru.objects.generated.ts`: `sys_import_job.created_count` and `sys_import_job.created_at` (around lines 3580 and 3633).
- `ar.objects.generated.ts`: `sys_oauth_resource.id` and `sys_oauth_resource.identifier`.
- `fr.objects.generated.ts`: `sys_user.accountable_user_id` and `sys_user.manager_id`, both "Responsable" (around lines 100 and 111).

**Reach.** Users of those three locales on the Setup surfaces that list those objects. No author door judges platform objects, so the new `field-label-duplicate` rule (#33545) does not catch these.

**Fix shape.** Three translated-locale string edits in the platform-objects bundles (values are hand-maintained; `pnpm check:i18n` gates them). Platform-objects i18n work, not the lint lane's; triage routes.

**Dedupe.** `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open duplicate label translation sys_user`: 4 hits, #33545 (the rule, which excludes platform bundles) and three seat posts.

Suggested-grade: p3 · cosmetic duplicate headers in three non-default locales.
